statistical_evaluation.trial_identity_policy: trial_id = sampling_plan_id + trial_index; duplicate identity is rejected

flaky.interpretation: Observed PASS/FAIL coexistence is a corpus observation, not proof of a live failure probability.

zero_tolerance.hard_block_rule: Any zero-tolerance event blocks regardless of aggregate success rate.

historical_regression.deterministic_rule: A required Historical Regression FAIL is a hard blocker.
